body:
Follow-up to the rejected Prism v1 screen (stephanelee/robocode#104). That screen failed only the Diamond Port gate (28.61% vs > 40%) and passed Retcon (94.33%), Adaptive Prime (69.29%) and the samples (100%).

**Status: registered, not run.** No v2 games have been played.

- **Evidence (Prism-side telemetry only):** against Diamond, Prism hit 7.5–8.4% of its confirmed shots, and the rate stayed flat across 5-round blocks (8.8 / 7.8 / 7.8 / 8.0%). Against Retcon and Adaptive Prime it hit 13–16%. Diamond's inferred hit rate on Prism stayed at 12–14%.
- **Hypothesis:** the learned guns train on per-tick virtual waves, while a wave surfer reacts only to the waves of real bullets. Profile 2 adds one `surfer` gun trained only on engine-confirmed bullet waves (windows 32/128/512, 5 neighbours, eligible after 8 labels), chosen only by the unchanged virtual selector. Nothing else changes.
- **Frozen screen:** 13 cold games / 200 rounds, same opponents and §13.3 gates as v1, fresh seeds 4201–4213. Candidate `Prism.jar` `3ed4935bf44595a8626a4525c905117a422999f2207d341a5b11a177d641b4fd`; source tree `a4c7b29c…`. Receipt `refs/tags/prism-screen-v2-3ed4935bf44595a8`. Exact-head clearance via `approvedHead`.
- **Decision rules:** an invalid game or any failed gate means reject, with no rerun or retune. A pass permits only "passed screen". Any superiority claim needs a separately registered confirmation.

Protocol: `docs/prism-surfer-gun-protocol.md`; plan: `docs/prism/screen-v2-plan.json`; workflow: `prism-screen-v2.yml` (manual, defaults to check-only). This needs an independent exact-head premeasurement review; the implementer will not approve or merge.
